summary: The August 2026 intelligence highlights significant land development and builder activity concentrated in Gaston, Cleveland, Mecklenburg, and Union counties. Cleveland County features large high-watch-score LLC-owned parcels, indicating strong future development potential. Gaston County stands out with multiple high-opportunity NC811 utility locate signals centered in Bessemer City, near clusters of tracked land parcels and high watch-score land, signaling heightened development and utility coordination needs. Union County presents active residential and economic development cases pending before county bodies, demonstrating ongoing growth momentum. Builder activity focuses on single-family homes, with Eastwood Homes and D.R. Horton actively selling lots primarily in Gaston and Mecklenburg. Effective GIS monitoring and proactive engagement around land parcels and locate signals in these counties will optimize development and infrastructure outcomes.
